matrix.details: FastAPI application entrypoint with lifespan event handlers, structured logging, CORS, and resilient startup without requiring trained numerical model weights.
Pydantic BaseSettings layer supporting dual-mode execution (direct/pooler), environment variable loading, Supabase alias mapping, and fallback defaults.
PostgreSQL database session manager configured for Supabase Transaction Pooler (port 6543) with statement_cache_size=0, SSL require, and verified SELECT 1 connectivity.
Structured endpoints: /nowcast, /inundation, /risk, /report-verification, /models/status, /runs/{run_id} with typed Pydantic models conforming to shared JSON schemas.
Genuine NASA GPM IMERG and NOAA GFS synoptic data adapters with spatial bounds [18.89, 19.30]N, [72.75, 73.05]E and explicit units mm/h.
Evidence quality checking, timestamp validation, spatial bounding, and physical rate range gating.
Persistence baseline and PySTEPS Lucas-Kanade optical flow advection nowcasting baseline operational.
PyTorch model architectures and serving loaders defined for ConvLSTM V3, U-Net + ConvGRU, and ST-Attention. Checkpoint training and tournament winner freeze paused for demo.
Produces structured provisional rainfall forecast with physical rate clamping when numerical models are absent, preserving source_mode=PROVISIONAL_AI.
LISFLOOD-FP hydrodynamic adapter, verified 6-scenario research corpus, square solver-grid logic, and explicit rainfall forcing semantics.
High-resolution Mumbai topographic susceptibility index based on DEM elevation, slope, curvature, and TWI. Strictly segregated from physical water depth.
Fourier Neural Operator model architecture and serving loader exist. Final GPU training and physical calibration are pending research tasks.
OpenStreetMap local geospatial asset ingestion for buildings, roadways, and critical facilities (Sion Hospital, Kurla Substation, railway culverts).
Geophysical vulnerability indexing based on elevation, drainage proximity, and slope. Social demographics remain explicitly unavailable.
Deterministic H x E x V risk engine producing continuous risk scores and categorical severity levels (LOW, MODERATE, HIGH, SEVERE) with explicit hazard type.
Multi-scenario spread and missing-data uncertainty estimation. Quality and confidence explicitly disentangled.
Machine-readable factor attribution breakdown (factor, direction, contribution, evidence source) and non-prescriptive advisory action recommendations.
Rules-based 8-layer corroboration engine verifying timestamp, spatial clustering, and environmental consistency without uncalibrated ML claims.
Model 1: Groq Provider with openai/gpt-oss-120b acting as primary generator.
Model 2: NVIDIA NIM Provider with nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b acting as fast secondary failover.
Model 3: NVIDIA NIM Provider with nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b acting as heavy verifier on HIGH/SEVERE risk or disagreement.
Preserves numerical forecast supremacy over AI text, clamps hallucinated rainfall rates to meteorological envelope, and enforces depth_m = null when numerical solver is absent.
SQLAlchemy ORM models and migrations for runs, assessments, citizen reports, and audit logs. Run traceability via run_id.
Truthful internal audit metadata tracking run_id, timestamp, source mode, provider, model ID, verifier verdict, evidence hash, and fallback reasons.
Model and data registry tracking availability states: unavailable, experimental, smoke_only, validated, operational.
Health and model status endpoints reporting backend, database, ML services, evidence pipelines, and model states without exposing credentials.
Zero committed credentials, gitignored environment files, masked provider names in frontend payloads, and service role backend isolation.
Shared OpenAPI contracts, TypeScript-ready JSON schemas, and clear developer onboarding documentation. Integration requires only BACKEND_BASE_URL.
Shared Pydantic/JSON schemas, CAP 1.2 alert schemas, and offline-first mobile design specifications. Integration requires only BACKEND_BASE_URL.
